Youth falls to death from hospital after allegedly stealing mobile

A youth died after falling from the third floor of the Civil Hospital in Sonipat, Haryana, on Tuesday. The incident occurred after the youth allegedly stole a mobile phone from a female patient in the medical ward. When hospital staff pursued him, he reportedly jumped from the third floor. Police are investigating the matter.
